breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still includes 'Calculate the second moment of area I using the formula I = π d^4/64' as an explicit step, perpetuating the erroneous instruction from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removes this entirely, as I = πd⁴/64 has no role in torsion calculations. While the generated spec correctly uses J in the torsion formulas (τ_max = Tc/J and φ = TL/(JG)), retaining the calculation of I implies it is still relevant to the torsion analysis, which contradicts the ground truth's correction.
